Furthermore, the P/B ratio of 9.61x [E2] also indicates an overvaluation compared to the sector benchmark of 4.69x [E7]. This suggests that the stock may be overvalued by approximately 34%. However, this does not justify the current valuation given the DCF analysis and other metrics.
